description: Compressed minified JavaScript plugin for jGrowl notifications, implementing a jQuery plugin for displaying growl-like notifications.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new notification with specified message and options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a notification element based on message and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates notification list, removing expired notifications and rendering new ones.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the notification container and starts the update interval.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Removes all notifications and stops the update interval.
